It's Raining Cats and Dogs

Sometimes people say it's raining cats and dogs outside. That could just be an American expression, I'm not sure. It doesn't make sense, but now with Rainaissance's new emoji feature, you can literally rain cats and dogs on your Mac.😺🐶

This update included a bit of rework to the menu bar view as well to accommodate the new emoji mode. I think it looks better than ever and has a good glassy feel on macOS 26+.

I received some feedback on licensing issues that this update also resolves. As always, please contact me at hey@rainaissance.app if you have any issues with Rainaissance. Thanks for being amazing customers and enjoy the incredible atmosphere Rainaissance brings to your daily Mac life.
